name: vibera_state
description: Read bounded project/editor/transport state, without plugin state or sample paths.

historyNotifications.description: Post-commit control work. Pending notification does not undo a completed mutation; asynchronous request acceptance never proves observer delivery.

instrumentOpening.description: UI Channel-name intent waiting for its matching projection/canonical admission; not an accepted native job or completed editor. MCP clients request openEditor after preparation, retry explicit busy, and poll actual job outcomes.

pluginSourceState.description: Ordinary prepared live-plugin context. active requires a successfully closed physical source callback; pending/arm is not audio completion. controlOnly permits device-free native controls, not live DSP.

sendAutomationHealthy.description: Selected Mixer send/Master-gate evaluator fault readback; null without an Edit. true is not an audible activation/settling acknowledgement.

pluginTransportPackets.description: Prepared worker pipeline quanta. Zero means no ordinary live source projection; latencySamples includes this transport.

maximumPhysicalFrames.description: Admitted maximum physical callback frames, independent of UI/MCP request sizes. Ordinary replacement supports at most one native device quantum.

maximumSourceFrames.description: Prepared source-frame quota for the admitted physical callback and native speed envelope; not actual frames processed.

pluginDeviceEpoch.description: Runtime physical device identity; same-rate/same-buffer restart changes it. Zero when no ordinary live source projection exists.

auxiliaryInputBus.description: Actual negotiated native input bus; -1 means none. Requested detector assignment uses plugin.effect.sidechain; this field reports actual worker negotiation, not a capability catalogue or proof of current audio activation.

auxiliaryInputChannels.description: Actual negotiated detector channels; not a catalogue of all plugin bus capabilities.

auxiliaryRejected.description: Sticky invalid detector-buffer count. Samples became silence; export cannot report successful delivery.

bypassTransitionSamples.description: Prepared five-millisecond healthy bypass ramp in samples. Initial bypass and failed-worker fallback are immediate.

bypassBlend.description: Actual processing readback:0 wet,1 latency-aligned dry (silent for instruments); null before processing. Model target commits separately from DSP settling.

wetBlend.description: Actual last processing-owner host wet-ramp value; null before processing. Effective processed contribution also depends on bypassBlend. Separate snapshots are not an atomic combined frame or heard-output proof.

latencyDeclared.description: Latest coherent native declaration in samples. Generation is scoped to worker instance; neither declares graph adoption.

latencyConsumed.description: Actual wet packet consumed by the processing owner; dry bypass uses this same latency. Null before consumption or during bounded publication. This is not a graph/PDC completion acknowledgement.

lastTweakedPlugin.description: Newest unambiguous completed native parameter gesture, or null. Not arbitrary native widget control. Rediscover after worker/project replacement or notification changes.

completedTicks.description: Monotonic native completion stamp; ordering only, not musical time.

order.description: Stable IDs in actual saved/UI display order, including Master.

insertCreationAvailable.description: Model capacity/solo eligibility. Current recording/gesture/file/native preparation prerequisites still apply to actual asynchronous admission.

available.description: Model target eligibility with explicit requiredDeletePolicy; actual application/native admission can refuse busy or incompatible recording.

projectIdentity.description: Operation source session; historical jobs retain their original identity.

revision.description: Current Studio revision; use destinationRevision for the historical job.

stage.description: Structural effect phase: capture,workers,prepareGraph,membership,settling,cancelling or terminal; empty for existing synchronous routing preparation.

referenceStart.description: Actual selected callback reference sample start, not beat time.

referenceEnd.description: Half-open actual callback reference sample end.

open.description: Actual Settings Plugins component is visible; not OS foreground or a loaded plugin acknowledgement.

targetCurrent.description: Target belongs to the current project identity.

insert.description: Existing Mixer index,0 Master; null when unavailable/stale.

projectIdentity.description: Current browser target binding, or empty when unavailable/stale.

insertsPlugin.description: Opening this browser never creates a plugin or starts a scan.

visible.description: Logical pane has usable geometry; not physical-screen visibility.

offset.description: Clamped first visible slot; zero-based, not a plugin ID.

wetGesture.description: Pending UI host wet edit, using the same canonical plugin.effect.mix/history as semantic mixerEffects(sourceInsert) gesture. Values in plugin list are live model previews; wetBlend is actual processing readback. Null is no UI owner, never proof of completed or audibly settled audio.

reorder.description: Pending UI-only grip intent; model/audio/history remain unchanged until drop's canonical plugin.effect.move. Null means no current intent, not proof of a successful move. Semantic equivalent is plugin.effect.move with projectIdentity/revision guards; read actual ordered IDs afterward.

valid.description: Exact source project/revision/insert/order/descriptor still match; application busy admission checked again on drop.

serial.description: Current or last take identity, scoped to this application instance;0 means none. Retry/cancel require the exact positive current token.

pending.description: Retained envelope after capture stops; capture acceptance is not note commit.

committedRevision.description: Terminal revision; committed note count is meaningful only in completed phase.

noteCount.description: Retained or completed count; held notes and pending input are separate and partial invalid data is never a completed take.

canRetry.description: Current admission only; memory or source validation can still refuse.

quantizerPreview.description: Actual local Quantizer preview. Null before opening; pending retains its original owner/baseline after refused Accept. Finish or cancel before file operations.

name: vibera_commands
description: Discover registered operations, explicit mappings/gaps and optional typed argument contracts. Paginated; includeSchemas=true with a command ID retrieves its contract.

name: vibera_command
description: Execute an undoable document edit, undo or redo on this owned instance. Optional revision rejects stale edits.

name: vibera_select
description: Select existing Pattern/Channel/editor scope or an already loaded project plugin UI. Plugin requests are separate from Pattern/Channel selection; no discovery, plugin loading, parameter writes or filesystem access.

name: vibera_transport
description: Play, stop, seek, set whole-Pattern/Song looping or switch mode through shared application actions. previewNote (stopped transport only) plays one note on a Channel through every current setting, like the sampler Preview processed button; pitch defaults to the sampler root (60 when Auto). State is not listening evidence.

enabled.description: For action loop: idempotently enable/disable entire current Pattern or Song looping. No recording take may be active when changing it.

range.description: For action loop: set the Playlist time selection [startBeat, endBeat] (null clears it). In Song mode looping plays only the selection; it is also the audio punch range.

name: vibera_editor
description: Show, hide or maximize a native JUCE editor: 0 Rack, 1 Piano, 2 Playlist, 3 Mixer.

target.description: Only editor1/action laneTarget: the note property the Piano roll event lane shows and paints (notes.velocity args.text). Read back as state.pianoLaneTarget.

chord.description: Only action stamp: a Chordify shape name (e.g. major, minor) so drawing a Piano roll note places that chord; empty turns the stamp off. Read back as state.pianoStamp.

enabled.description: Only editor2/action grouping: temporarily enable/disable group targeting; retain membership. Refused during active gestures.

snap.description: Only action snap: the shared Piano roll/Playlist grid in beats (0 = none; e.g. 0.25 step, 1/3 triplet, 4 bar). Read back as state.snap.

line.description: Only action snap: true snaps pointer edits to the visible grid lines (zoom dependent) instead of snap; read back as state.snapLine.

markers.description: Only action snap: true snaps Playlist positions to markers (distances to bars); read back as state.snapMarkers.

name: vibera_update
description: In-app updates from the project's GitHub Releases. status reads the phase (idle, checking, upToDate, available, downloading, ready, installing, failed), the current version, the newest available release with its notes and installable asset, download progress and the update settings. check starts a background check (poll status; completes as upToDate, available or failed) without opening dialogs. Downloading and installing need the user's approval in the app (Tools > Check for updates), so they are not MCP actions.

name: vibera_snapshot
description: Capture this instance as a bounded JUCE component PNG including the header. With channel: that local Channel's settings window instead (opened if needed) (page 0 Sample, 1 Envelope, 2 Miscellaneous). Not native PrintWindow, physical input or listening evidence.

name: vibera_key
description: Run an allowed contextual shortcut through the real JUCE handler. File/dialog/macro commands and held typing-performance input are excluded. Not OS keyboard input.

name: vibera_pointer
description: Run paired down/drag/up or cancel through actual editor/child mouse handlers, or one wheel step (phase wheel, deltaY; positive is up/away). Logical editor pixels from state; left/right/middle/x1 buttons. Not global or physical mouse input.

name: vibera_controller
description: Global state/setBinding use atomic settings persistence. samplerLearnStart/State/Accept/Cancel learn fixed project-owned sampler CC links through canonical document history; start/capture remain pending until explicit acceptance. Save the project separately. Existing injection/ports/preset remain owned-test diagnostics only.

nativeArea.description: 0 normal,1 MK3 pots,2 MK3 faders. Existing exact mode/port/channel/CC validation retained; send requires0.

expectedProfile.description: Required for setBinding. Exact controllerProfileIdentity from state; binds runtime mappings and available saved bytes. Re-read after any mapping/bank/profile change.

targetChannel.description: Fixed existing local sampler Channel ID captured for this operation.

samplerParameter.description: Stable destination*32+field sampler parameter code; code0 is valid. See samplerAutomationContract for physical units/ranges and tempo behavior.

name: vibera_macros
description: Inspect/persist saved macros through the SAME Customization supported-command predicate, authoritative command schemas and Settings application service. Run the real saved-recipe runner with one history transaction, or its existing asynchronous Channel-routing service. Other shortcut/settings editing remains outside this tool. Completed means canonical history/configuration, never DSP/native readiness; routing runs return their actual pending operation for vibera_mixer routingJob polling.

id.description: Stable macro.* ID; state optionally returns its complete recipe, remove/run require it. No name or row alias.

generation.description: Required unchanged state generation for create/update/remove/run. Includes canonical settings and exact saved-profile identity. Re-read after any profile edit; stale refuses before work.

includeSchemas.description: state only: registry-derived explicit/current-context command schemas for this bounded Mixer recipe subset.

action.description: Exact actual Customization-supported canonical command ID from state.supportedCommands/vibera_commands; no toolbar simulation.

parameters.description: Validated against registry-derived command schema; state includeSchemas supplies explicit/current-context forms.

currentContext.description: Resolves active insert/selection/group at run. Group creation passes its new UUID to following context steps; explicit targets remain exact IDs.

generation.description: SHA256 of canonical full settings and exact persisted bytes, or absent marker.

profileReadbackScope.description: Run retains the exact admitted settings snapshot; later external profile changes do not conceal accepted async routing. Re-inspect state for current configuration.

configurationCommitted.description: True only for actual successful create/update/remove disk and memory publication; run is a musical history action.

routing.description: Actual shared routing-job state; poll vibera_mixer action=routingJob with operation until terminal. Published routing requires checked Undo; cancelRouting honestly reports tooLate.

name: vibera_samplerTempo
description: Shared source-bound sampler tempo workflow. state reads prepared source and current settings; capture snapshots settings for manual confirmation; detect analyzes immutable PCM off-thread without editing. Poll job until completed/failed/cancelled. apply explicitly commits a captured or detected result as one Undo step. Cancellation never edits. Fit is RESAMPLE (changes pitch), not stretch. Beats are quarter notes in the trimmed source; bars use current document meter. Requires a prepared sample Channel, not a streamed Audio Clip or VST3. Sessions retain at most32 records; old finished tokens may expire.

channel.description: Stable Channel ID; required for state/capture/detect.

operation.description: Exact token from capture/detect; required for job/cancel/apply.

sourceBpm.description: apply only. Explicit source BPM; omitted uses the completed estimate or captured source tempo.

beats.description: apply only. Musical duration of the trimmed source, in quarter notes; exclusive with bars/sourceBpm. Enables fit by default.

bars.description: apply only. Trimmed source duration in current document bars; exclusive with beats/sourceBpm. Enables fit by default.

fit.description: apply only. Omitted preserves captured fit for BPM, enables fit for beats/bars. Resampling changes pitch with duration.

operations.description: Current-project retained session tokens for this Channel, including UI-created sessions. Poll job for actual outcome.

name: vibera_automationRecording
description: Shared Song-mode MIDI Mixer automation take. Arm one existing insert's gain/pan/separation and current sends; existing linked/initialized automation refuses. Controller values after pickup use actual producer source-clock stamps. Value is a real semantic manual edit recorded at backend source time, never MIDI injection or caller-supplied time. Finish creates ordinary Automation Clips in one Undo; cancel restores exact preview baseline. Pattern, loops, overwrite/overdub and native parameter recording are explicitly unsupported by this bounded increment. MIDI notes retain independent capture/history. No physical input/listening or DSP settling claim.

insert.description: Required arm: existing stable insert, Master allowed without sends.

token.description: Exact active take token; required value/finish/retry/cancel.

sendTarget.description: Required only for control=send; exact existing destination,0 Master.

offset.description: State only; active captured event pagination. After completion inspect actual canonical sources/points.

name: vibera_effects
description: Discover individually insertable built-in VibeRa effects. Always available without installation or scanning. Get an exact descriptor then use canonical plugin.effect.insert/replace, existing Mixer slot controls and vibera_plugin parameter/history services. Each instance has one fixed effect type.

type.description: Exact effect type slug from list; required only for descriptor.

name: vibera_synth
description: Bundled native VibeRa Synthesizer. Genre/family/search/favorites use the exact native browser preference service; navigation and preview are transient. Discover stable preset IDs and parameter keys/ranges first. loadPreset/loadUserPreset use the existing native scalar ACK plus captured project Undo job; poll vibera_plugin job/cancel until terminal. Native editor operations use the established acknowledged editor service. No external scan, provider, account or network is needed.

name.description: User preset basename inside the writable Synthesizer directory, without extension or path separators.

name: vibera_note_modes
description: Shared Piano Roll insertion modes,16 note-color/MIDI groups and captured Note Properties. Configure changes session insertion defaults, not score/history. changeColour edits explicit/current selected source IDs (all current Channel notes when selection is empty); selectColour changes selection only. propertiesOpen captures exact project/revision/Pattern/Channel/IDs. propertiesUpdate stages a sparse patch; Reset restores its initial values, Cancel preserves score. Apply uses one atomic canonical notes.properties command/Undo. Source metadata is not a DSP acknowledgement. Slide/Porta/Pan/Fine/Mod X/Y require a local sampler; third-party native widgets/transitions are unsupported. Ordinary note colors reach supported hosted instruments as MIDI channels1..16.

colourGroup.description: Stable note-color index0..15; displayed1..16. Distinct from DAW Channel ID and selection-group ID.

operation.description: Exact properties operation token, required after open; stale windows cannot affect a newer operation.

noteProperties.description: Sparse atomic Note Properties. Timing/pitch only for one selected Note; Manual-window dormant notes retained. Sampler-only fields refuse hosted targets. One exact Undo/gesture, no clamping or model-to-DSP completion claim.

name: vibera_plugin
description: Discover loaded project built-in effects and VST3 instruments/effects with native parameter metadata, refresh/prepare automation asynchronously, open shared Controls or the actual native editor with acknowledged outcomes, inspect native window state, toggle session notifications or recover saved state. Uses the same application services as UI. Supported normalized scalar writes are async actual ACK plus fresh-state history jobs (active MIDI takes use explicit ACK-only writes without state capture/history); Undo/Redo use bounded structural restoration. Arbitrary hidden/program state and native widgets are unsupported. Poll jobs until terminal; recovery can lose uncaptured state/restart voices.

action.description: openEditor/closeEditor require exact current plugin/instance, no physical editor/state/parameter/catalogue or file work in flight; accepted requests are pending and must be polled via job. editorState is non-mutating. Cancellation before dispatch only; too_late requires outcome polling. Window operations do not enter project Undo or expose arbitrary native widgets.

name: vibera_catalogue
description: Shared Windows x64 VST3 Settings discovery service. Read configured/standard folders, scan progress/results/blacklist, resolve stable catalogue IDs to descriptors for canonical plugin creation commands, start/rescan or request cancellation. Scans are asynchronous and global to this app, not project Undo. Poll the operation until terminal; per-plugin failures are blacklisted and reported. Standard locations default to the configured value (initially true). Test mode uses a disposable catalogue and never modifies user plugin settings.

id.description: Opaque stable class ID from list; never a row index.

customFolders.description: Absolute Windows folder paths. Omitted retains configured folders; empty scans only standard locations when enabled.

standardLocations.description: Include standard VST3 locations; omitted retains configuration, initially true.

retryBlacklisted.description: Explicitly retry previously failed bundles. Cancellation retains the previous blacklist/catalogue/settings.

name: vibera_stretch
description: Shared nondestructive Piano Roll selection stretch. Begin captures explicit notes and their earliest onset anchor. Update sets an absolute time/duration ratio against the unchanged source. Commit is one canonical edit; cancel/expiry leaves source/history/audio untouched. Poll actual completion and planned notes. Source-dependent ratio limits are returned. Score scaling does not time-stretch audio files.

ratio.description: Absolute duration/onset scale about the returned anchor, not incremental; limits depend on the selected source.

name: vibera_dialog
description: Test mode only: read or answer the app's open modal JUCE dialog in-process (no OS input). state lists its title, text fields and buttons; submit sets fields by name and presses the named button through its real handler.

name: vibera_slice
description: Shared Piano Roll cut-line preview/session. Begin captures the current Pattern/Channel; update validates a musical line and returns planned targets without mutating score/audio/history. Commit executes canonical notes.slice once; cancel/lease expiry leaves the source unchanged. Local actions preempt remote preview. Poll state for actual terminal outcomes and actual created right-note IDs; no pointer simulation. Empty IDs target the active part unless line.allChannels explicitly includes ghosts. Preview is not a completed edit.

startBeat.description: Start quarter-note beat in the source Pattern, not Song time.

endBeat.description: End quarter-note beat; may precede startBeat for reverse strokes.

startPitch.description: Continuous MIDI semitones; an integer is the row centre, edges are pitch +/-0.5.

endPitch.description: End continuous pitch; may precede startPitch.

grid.description: Snap each intersection to this beat grid. Zero bypasses; nonzero minimum1/960 beat.

allChannels.description: With empty IDs, include all Pattern parts (editable ghosts). False limits to the specified active Channel. Explicit IDs always bound targets.

loopPreview.description: Intersect displayed Channel-loop occurrences and edit their original source notes. Conflicting source cut positions are refused atomically.

name: vibera_selection
description: Semantic note/Playlist clip selection through the shared UI selection model. Stable IDs in the currently selected Pattern; no document change or Undo entry. Range selection uses note starts or overlap in quarter-note beats, inclusive MIDI pitches or zero-based lanes.

low.description: Inclusive MIDI pitch for notes or lane index for clips.

loopPreview.description: Only notes/range. Apply the starts or overlaps criterion to the Piano Roll loop occurrence view and select distinct real source IDs, including raw dormant notes. Never materializes copies or changes musical state.

name: vibera_gesture
description: Leased continuous canonical document edits, sharing the UI gesture/Undo implementation. Begin returns an ownership token; update applies one command live; commit creates one Undo step; cancel restores the exact starting project/dirty state. Local UI edits preempt and cancel the remote gesture. Only state/inspect/discovery and this tool are admitted while owned. Poll state to verify cancellation or expiry; no mouse simulation.

domain.description: stepVelocity leases only steps.velocity on the active Pattern/Channel, so a held MIDI take can continue. stepGraph permits steps.pitch/steps.velocity and steps.shift/steps.repeat/steps.release plus local-sampler-only steps.pan/steps.fine/steps.modX/steps.modY on its captured Pattern/Channel with the same history/recording policy. stepActivation permits only steps.set on its captured Pattern/Channel, retaining an armed or actively capturing MIDI take. Raw source positions, the Workflow retention policy and canonical validation remain authoritative; retained pending takes still refuse begin. swing leases only project.swing/channel.swingMix on the active target and also retains recording. noteMute leases only notes.mute/unmute in its original Pattern/context and retains a held MIDI take. samplerVoices leases Cut/Cut-by/Cut-itself/Max-poly plus Mono/Portamento/Slide time/Gate/Full portamento on the captured local sampler Channel. samplerModulation leases only canonical modulation parameters on the captured local sampler Channel, preserving armed/capturing MIDI. samplerFilter leases only local sampler filterType/filterCutoff/filterResonance on the original selected Channel and retains armed or capturing MIDI. Document domain refuses armed recording. name: vibera_picker
description: Semantic Playlist Picker selection, filtering, navigation and source placement. Uses the same component model/canonical commands as UI, without mouse simulation.

scrollY.description: Logical vertical pixels; maximumScrollY is returned in state.

name: vibera_project
description: Shared application new/open/save/export and asynchronous job status. Absolute paths; existing outputs require overwrite=true, dirty replacement requires discardChanges=true. Save/export returns pending until job poll is completed/failed. exportMidi snapshots the selected Piano Roll Channel part at 960 PPQ, encodes Shift and Repeat timing once but remains unswung and uncropped, omits muted notes and per-note Pan/Fine Pitch/Mod X/Y (MIDI1 score cannot retain them). Color groups encode MIDI channels1..16. The Channel's CC, pitch bend, channel pressure and program changes are exported at their beats. Silent Slide events are omitted; per-note Porta is not emulated. Successful export reports expressionNotesOmitted as the union of unsupported occurrences plus midiExpressionNotesOmitted/midiSlideNotesOmitted/midiPortamentoNotesOmitted details; pending/failed counts remain null. Project/WAV preserve expression. Reports actual job outcome. Song export 48kHz/Song/cut-tail matches UI; the path extension picks the format: .wav (24-bit), .flac (24-bit lossless), .ogg (Vorbis 256 kbps) or .mp3 (320 kbps through a user-installed LAME: lame.exe on PATH or VIBERA_LAME_EXECUTABLE; the job fails truthfully without it), encoded after rendering. stems=true exports one WAV per Mixer insert fed by a Channel into the folder path. export with pattern=<stable Pattern ID> renders only that Pattern once from beat0 (no Playlist clips/automation clips). savePreset/loadPreset take channel and an absolute .vibch path: savePreset captures fresh native state for instrument Channels before writing (job may be pending); loadPreset applies the file as one Undo step (sample found beside the preset when moved). With pattern and placeClip=true the path is ignored: the WAV goes to the project's Rendered folder (Documents/VibeRa Studio/Rendered when unsaved) and, after the job completes, is imported as a Playlist audio clip at the Pattern's first placement on the first free lane (its own Undo step; read clips to confirm).

track.description: importMidi: only this 1-based MIDI track (default all).

blend.description: importMidi: keep the Channel's existing notes and controllers (default replaces them).

realign.description: importMidi: move the first note to beat 0.

split.description: importMidi: one new Channel per MIDI track with notes, each a settings clone of the target Channel named after its track (blend is ignored).

useTempo.description: importMidi: also replace the project tempo map and time signature with the file's (same Undo step). Notes, CC, pitch bend, channel pressure and program changes go into the Pattern (default selected) for the Channel (default selected); program changes reach plugin instruments in playback.

on.description: perform: launch (true) or stop (false) the Pattern. Launched Patterns are placed on the next bar on their own lane (64+) and repeat until stopped; stopping the transport ends the performance.

offset.description: video: seconds of video at Song time zero.

sensitivity.description: sliceChannel: onset sensitivity (higher finds more slices, at most 16). Creates one sampler Channel per slice and a Pattern replaying them (one Undo).

edit.description: editClip: offline edit into a new source file (one Undo). consolidate bakes the clip window and its fades; pitch shifts by value semitones keeping the length.

value.description: editClip: normalize target dBFS (-48..0, default -0.3 in the UI), gain dB (+/-48) or pitch semitones (-24..24, nonzero).

bpm.description: warpClip: tempo the clip was played at (default the base tempo). Each source beat is rendered onto the matching Song beat from the clip start, following tempo jumps and ramps (pitch kept, new file, one Undo).

ratio.description: stretchClip: new length / old length (2 = half speed), pitch kept.

beats.description: stretchClip: fit the clip to this many beats instead of a ratio. alignClip: grid in beats (default 0.25); the clip and its take group move so the first transient lands on the nearest grid line (one Undo).

mixer.description: saveTrackState/openTrackState: the Mixer track; path is an absolute .vibfx directly in the configured chain preset directory. Save writes the effect chain plus the track controls; Open applies the chain, then the controls (one Undo step each).

enabled.description: effectSmartDisable: turn smart disable on (true) or off for the VibeRa effect in plugin. When on, after a second of silent input and output the effect stops processing until input returns (saves CPU; tails finish first). The effect restarts with the new state; read effects[].smartDisable in vibera_mixer state.

plugin.description: effectImpulse/effectSmartDisable: the effect's plugin ID; for effectImpulse the Convolution Reverb's (vibera_plugin list); path is the absolute WAV/AIFF/FLAC impulse. The job completes when the reload is requested; read the effect state (e.g. after save) to confirm.

template.description: new: empty, demo, or the name of a user project template (listed by action templates); saveTemplate: the template name to write (overwrites one of the same name).

overwrite.description: diagnostics: replace an existing report. diagnostics writes a shareable text report (version, OS, audio device, plugin workers, recent errors) to the absolute .txt path with the user folder and name replaced, and returns it as report.

sampleRate.description: export: render rate (kept for later exports; default 48000).

tail.description: export: what happens after the Song end (kept for later exports; default cut): cut stops there, leave keeps effect tails until silence (at most 8 s), wrap mixes the tails onto the start for seamless loops.

bitDepth.description: export: WAV bits, 32 = float (kept for later exports; default 24). FLAC uses 24-bit, OGG/MP3 their codec.

stems.description: export only: path is a folder; one WAV per Mixer insert fed by a Channel ('NN Name.wav'), each rendered with that insert soloed with its connections.

armedOnly.description: export with stems=true: render only the Mixer tracks armed for rendering (vibera_command mixer.renderArm toggles the selected track; state.mixerRenderArmed lists them).

name: vibera_batch
description: Execute 1-64 canonical document commands in one undoable transaction. Validation failure rolls back the full batch. No file/runtime/UI actions or pointer simulation.

name: vibera_mixer
description: Select an existing Mixer source insert through the shared UI application command, inspect routes, availability and controls, or clear transient per-side sample-overload indications. Selection is workspace state, not project Undo. Edit routes with canonical mixer.route/mixer.routeOnly/mixer.send. Native third-party UI is not exposed. browseEffects navigates the actual Settings Plugins browser for an exact existing insert; scrollEffects scrolls ordered slots. Neither inserts or opens a plugin.

insert.description: Existing Mixer insert index, required for select/resetOverload/browseEffects. browseEffects opens Settings Plugins for this exact insert without inserting a plugin; read effectsBrowser for actual navigation state. Master0 allowed. Reset requires prepared meter, clears sample-overload latches through its returned completed-block fence; in-flight/new overload can re-latch. Transient/no Undo, project change or recording interruption.

offset.description: Required for scrollEffects; zero-based first visible slot, at most effectsPane.maximumOffset for current insert. Navigation only; no Undo.

ids.description: Current stable insert IDs. Multi-selection is workspace state, separate from the active send source, and never persisted/Undoable.

mode.description: selectMany only. range takes one destination and current anchor in current display order; at least one insert remains selected.

active.description: selectMany only; exact selected source. Omitted resolves deterministically after membership changes. Does not assign a send destination.

group.description: selectGroup only; existing UUID group from organisation readback.

operation.description: Required for routingJob/cancelRouting and retryDevicePreparation/cancelDevicePreparation; optional for devicePreparationState. Routing retains32 terminal jobs; device preparation retains current token only.

open.description: Actual Settings Plugins component is visible; not OS foreground or a loaded plugin acknowledgement.

targetCurrent.description: Target belongs to the current project identity.

insert.description: Existing Mixer index,0 Master; null when unavailable/stale.

projectIdentity.description: Current browser target binding, or empty when unavailable/stale.

insertsPlugin.description: Opening this browser never creates a plugin or starts a scan.

visible.description: Logical pane has usable geometry; not physical-screen visibility.

offset.description: Clamped first visible slot; zero-based, not a plugin ID.

wetGesture.description: Pending UI host wet edit, using the same canonical plugin.effect.mix/history as semantic mixerEffects(sourceInsert) gesture. Values in plugin list are live model previews; wetBlend is actual processing readback. Null is no UI owner, never proof of completed or audibly settled audio.

reorder.description: Pending UI-only grip intent; model/audio/history remain unchanged until drop's canonical plugin.effect.move. Null means no current intent, not proof of a successful move. Semantic equivalent is plugin.effect.move with projectIdentity/revision guards; read actual ordered IDs afterward.

valid.description: Exact source project/revision/insert/order/descriptor still match; application busy admission checked again on drop.

insertCreationAvailable.description: Model capacity/solo eligibility. Current recording/gesture/file/native preparation prerequisites still apply to actual asynchronous admission.

available.description: Model target eligibility with explicit requiredDeletePolicy; actual application/native admission can refuse busy or incompatible recording.

revision.description: Current Studio revision; use destinationRevision for the historical job.

stage.description: Structural effect phase: capture,workers,prepareGraph,membership,settling,cancelling or terminal; empty for existing synchronous routing preparation.

referenceStart.description: Actual selected callback reference sample start, not beat time.

referenceEnd.description: Half-open actual callback reference sample end.

name: vibera_inspect
description: Paginated canonical project state, using stable IDs. Notes and noteOccurrences use the supplied or active Pattern. noteOccurrences exposes raw sources plus non-persistent Channel-loop appearances with real sourceId, iteration and display geometry; edits always target sourceId, never display beat or iteration. Does not expose opaque plugin state blobs.

group.description: Required for clipGroupMembers; paginated stable member IDs.

source.description: Required only for automationPoints/automationLinks; stable Automation source ID, not placement.

name: vibera_rack
description: Shared Channel Rack selection/filtering, groups and asynchronous settings-only Channel clone/delete. Clone/delete capture selected plugin state before one document transaction; poll job/cancel until terminal, then read audio/plugin preparation health separately. Reorder uses channel.moveUp/moveDown via vibera_command. Filtering never changes routing or the active MIDI target. Discover stable IDs first.

operation.description: Current-session Channel clone/delete job ID, required for job/cancel. Poll until terminal. Completion means the actual document transaction committed after state capture; read audio state for subsequent engine preparation/plugin health.

muteRemovedSteps.description: configure only: persist the Workflow preference. False deletes removed step chords; true retains their source IDs/properties as muted notes. Reactivation restores them. Initially false for legacy compatibility; not musical Undo. Do not combine with another persistent preference or graph changes. Activation edits the raw source position, independently of playback-loop repetition or shrinkage.

restoreMuteAfterSolo.description: For configure: persist the Workflow solo-restore preference before changing live settings. Initially true. Preferences are not musical Undo.

graphProperty.description: For configure: select the graph property through the shared view service. Session view state, not musical Undo. Do not combine with restoreMuteAfterSolo or muteRemovedSteps. Pitch has MIDI0-127 units/reset60; local sampler Pan normalized-1..1 and Fine Pitch cents-100..100 reset0. Shift percent0-100 resets0 and delays percent*0.002475 quarter-note beats; supported on all score instruments. Repeat selects rhythmic rate0-14 (Off through64th triplet), all score instruments; source duration gates repeats and source IDs remain stable. Release normalized0..1/default0 is MIDI note-off data, not ADSR duration; local sampler and current native Synth ignore it, other instruments are patch-dependent. Native/VST3 pan/fine unsupported. Mod X/Y0..1 neutral0.5 offset local sampler filter cutoff/resonance using original clamp(global+2*(note-0.5),0,1); Filter Off is a no-op. Native/VST3 Mod X/Y unsupported; source metadata is not a voice/DSP ACK. Edit canonical steps.pitch/pan/fine/shift/repeat/release/modX/modY via stepGraph lease.

graphVisible.description: For configure: show/hide the selected-Channel step Graph Editor. Initially false; session view state, not musical Undo. Ctrl+K/UI share this service. Edit existing in-window on-grid source steps (including muted/zero-velocity notes, retaining activation) through steps.velocity and vibera_gesture domain=stepVelocity. Pitch/Pan/Fine/Shift/Repeat/Release/Mod X/Mod Y use graphProperty and canonical steps.pitch/pan/fine/shift/repeat/release/modX/modY, with stepGraph history. Pan/Fine and Mod X/Y require local sampler targets. Other properties remain unsupported.

firstRow.description: For scroll: zero-based visible Channel row, clamped to viewport bounds. Omit to retain.

firstStep.description: For scroll: zero-based step column, clamped to the full explicit Pattern length. Omit to retain.

kind.description: Required for filter. All/Unsorted are virtual views, not group IDs.

group.description: Stable group ID, required only for kind=group.

ids.description: Stable Channel IDs, required for select. Group/clone/delete default to shared Rack selection; explicit clone/delete needs 1..128 IDs. Clone inserts settings-only copies adjacent to each source and selects them; delete removes their notes in every Pattern and owned Audio Clips, never files.

activeChannel.description: Optional explicit active instrument/MIDI recipient. Selection alone preserves the active recipient and held take.

allChannels.description: For all: true selects the whole project; false selects visible rows.

name.description: For group: existing or new name, 1..128 characters, no outer spaces, All/Unsorted reserved. One Undo includes creation and assignment.

name: vibera_stepCompose
description: Shared Advanced Fill: multi-Channel drafts, Manual/Every-N/Euclidean/Dice/rotation, baseline-relative audible preview, exact Cancel and one-history Accept. Begin requires explicit Pattern and Channel IDs and no active recording/edit lease. Opening never changes score. Updates replace specified drafts, not incremental fields. Reset restores opening drafts. State includes final masks and actual pending/completed/cancelled outcomes; document completion does not acknowledge DSP adoption.

action.description: Solo requires enabled; temporary audition follows selection and restores opening mutes on Accept/Cancel. Dice advances the current draft seed; manual freezes its final mask.

operation.description: Exact pending token required for every mutation after begin. Read state to recover after disconnect.

channels.description: Begin requires explicit playable Channel IDs. MIDI target is unchanged.

channel.description: Select retained draft; never changes live MIDI recipient.

all.description: Reset restores opening draft for current Channel or all targets.

enabled.description: Required for preview or solo. Preview false restores opening score while retaining drafts and any active temporary Solo. Solo respects canonical mute locks.

channel.description: Existing stable instrument Channel ID, never a row index; Audio Clips excluded.

sequenceSteps.description: Source cycle in sixteenth-note cells; one cell=0.25 quarter-note beats. Replaces only source notes before cycle end.

mode.description: Original mask algorithm. Every starts at zero; Euclidean hits floor(k*steps/pulses).

every.description: Every-N spacing, must not exceed sequenceSteps in every mode.

pulses.description: Euclidean hit count, must not exceed sequenceSteps in euclidean mode.

rotation.description: Signed cell shift; positive moves later, modulo cycle.

dice.description: Redistribute generated hit count deterministically, before rotation.

loop.description: True sets this Pattern part's fixed cycle; false removes its loop and may reveal retained source notes beyond the replacement window.

convertMelodic.description: Explicit consent to floor in-cycle melodic/off-grid notes to step cells and set length0.25. Otherwise refuse atomically.

manual.description: Manual mode needs exactly sequenceSteps binary values.

completionState.description: Pending owns the live document preview; only Accept/Cancel/expiry reaches terminal state. Tool errors preserve the previous pending session for retry/cancel.

channel.description: Existing stable instrument Channel ID, never a row index; Audio Clips excluded.

sequenceSteps.description: Source cycle in sixteenth-note cells; one cell=0.25 quarter-note beats. Replaces only source notes before cycle end.

mode.description: Original mask algorithm. Every starts at zero; Euclidean hits floor(k*steps/pulses).

every.description: Every-N spacing, must not exceed sequenceSteps in every mode.

pulses.description: Euclidean hit count, must not exceed sequenceSteps in euclidean mode.

rotation.description: Signed cell shift; positive moves later, modulo cycle.

convertMelodic.description: Explicit consent to floor in-cycle melodic/off-grid notes to step cells and set length0.25. Otherwise refuse atomically.

manual.description: Manual mode needs exactly sequenceSteps binary values.

mask.description: Final post-Dice/rotation cells; not an accepted update field.

name: vibera_groove
description: Capture reusable note timing/velocity grooves, list original presets, validate/load/save bounded VibeRa.Groove templates and read active preview guides. These operations do not edit the project or create Undo; apply through canonical notes.quantize and optional vibera_gesture. File operations return completed only after actual synchronous I/O succeeds; no worker acceptance masquerades as completion.

pattern.description: Stable source Pattern for capture; defaults to active.

channel.description: Stable source Channel for capture; default active. Explicit note IDs may include ghosts.

ids.description: Capture notes. Empty uses current Channel. Selected onsets outside cycle are rejected.

cycleBeats.description: Capture period; defaults to source Pattern length. Keeps Pattern-zero phase; no implicit rebasing.

source.description: Capture from current score or original active Quantizer baseline (equivalent to modal Capture).

path.description: Absolute local template file. load limited to1MiB. No network operations.

overwrite.description: save refuses existing files unless true; never overwrites a directory.

format.description: Original VibeRa template format; proprietary FSC payloads are not supported.

cycleBeats.description: Repeating period in quarter-note beats; origin is Pattern zero, independent of time signature.

points.description: Strictly ascending unique starts; pitch is not stored. Capture keeps lowest stable ID at each chord onset.

beat.description: Onset within cycle, less than cycleBeats.

length.description: Quarter-note beats; may cross the cycle boundary.

velocity.description: Normalized level. Zero is an optional rest/deletion marker.

name: vibera_recording
description: Inspect, finish, retry or explicitly cancel the shared MIDI take owner. Arm/disarm with canonical vibera_command transport.record. Capture/pending is not note commit. Retry/cancel require the exact current positive take serial; completed/consumed tokens refuse. No MIDI injection, hardware claim or arbitrary audio-recording controls.

serial.description: Required only for retry/cancel. Exact token from recording readback; no default/current-token substitution.

offset.description: State only: offset into currently retained complete note segments. Held notes/pending input remain separate.

limit.description: State only: bounded read-only retained-note page; id0 is not a canonical project note ID.

recordArmed.description: Arm request only; not proof capture started or MIDI hardware worked.

serial.description: Current or last take identity, scoped to this application instance;0 means none. Retry/cancel require the exact positive current token.

pending.description: Retained envelope after capture stops; capture acceptance is not note commit.

committedRevision.description: Terminal revision; committed note count is meaningful only in completed phase.

noteCount.description: Retained or completed count; held notes and pending input are separate and partial invalid data is never a completed take.

canRetry.description: Current admission only; memory or source validation can still refuse.

releaseVelocity.description: Normalized physical MIDI note-off velocity; synthetic closes0, not ADSR duration.

releaseMidiVelocity.description: Rounded MIDI note-off byte; retained source state, not native delivery acknowledgement.

notesPartial.description: True for capturing/sealing/invalid capture; notes are diagnostic incomplete segments, not a completed take.

name: vibera_mixerchain
description: Shared Mixer chain Copy, atomic Save preset, Load to clipboard, destination Paste and Load-and-apply, plus session job/cancel and explicitly configured preset directory. Capture/file/preparation are asynchronous; poll until terminal. Paste/loadApply replace the destination chain through canonical one-Undo preparation and explicit audio suspend/reconfigure/resume; acceptance is not active playback. Copy/save/loadClipboard do not change Project/history/audio topology. Portable state excludes source IDs, routing and automation links. Referenced destination automation refuses rather than silently unlinking. Registration is not qualification; consult exact evidence.

mixer.description: Required existing destination for paste/loadApply or source for copy/save; Master0 supported. Sparse stable insert index, not display row.

projectIdentity.description: Required exact current project session for copy/save/paste/loadApply. Discover current identity first.

revision.description: Required exact current musical revision for copy/save/paste/loadApply; checked again after native capture, file loading and immediately before structural commit as applicable.

path.description: Required save/loadClipboard/loadApply absolute LOCAL .vibfx file, direct child of configured existing preset directory. No network, links, device paths or implicit overwrite.

directory.description: Required configureDirectory absolute existing LOCAL ordinary directory. No mkdir. One session worker; active work refuses reconfiguration, preserving old root.

overwrite.description: Save only. Explicit permission for atomic replacement; absent means no replacement.

operation.description: Required exact session-scoped job token for job/cancel. Compact terminal receipts live until Studio closes; opaque chains/native handles are not retained in job history.

nativeRecoveryRequired.description: True when irreversible publication requires explicit native recovery; never interpret as successful active playback.

recoveryOperation.description: Exact separately owned device-preparation operation, if automatic recovery was admitted. A chain timeout does not cancel or silently destroy this persistent owner; inspect vibera_mixer action=devicePreparation with this operation.

audioState.description: Apply audio projection state. Queued preparation/model acceptance is not actual active playback; deferredNoDevice has no active device. Published activation has a10000ms QPC bound; timeout fails retaining intended model/history with nativeRecoveryRequired.

name: vibera_ai
description: CoProducer (AI chat producer) and local AI music. state: provider/engine/job/chat status (never API keys), state.panel (docked CoProducer side panel) state.codex (local Codex CLI install/ChatGPT sign-in, models[] with slug/name/efforts/defaultEffort) and state.claudeCli (local Claude Code CLI install/sign-in/subscription, models aliases). Presets codex-cli and claude-cli use the user's ChatGPT or Claude subscription through the signed-in CLI instead of an API key; detectAgents re-checks both in the background (state.agent.detecting). configure: provider {preset, baseUrl, model, effort: "" (model default)|low|medium|high|xhigh|max|ultra; Codex sends it only when the model supports it; Claude Code accepts low..max}, write-only apiKey, music {aceStepUrl, aceStepAutoStart, yueLowVram, yueLicenseAccepted}, maxAgentSteps, agentMayEditProject. testConnection then state.connection: lists models. generateMusic: engine ace-step|yue2, prompt, lyrics, language, seconds 10..600, bpm 0|30..300, key, seed, instrumental, beat, lane; installs/starts the engine automatically on first use (large downloads), then places the audio as a Playlist clip (own Undo step); poll state.music. prepareEngine: install/check an engine without generating. cancelMusic, stopServer. chat: message to the in-app producer agent (it edits the project with the same canonical tools); events: since index; cancelChat; resetChat. panel: show/hide the docked CoProducer panel {visible, tab chat|midi}.

name: vibera_audioRecording
description: Audio-input recording (microphone/instrument through the audio device). configure: enabled, input (first device input channel, 0-based), channels 1 mono|2 stereo, tracks 1..8 (record that many separate input tracks at once from consecutive inputs, each `channels` wide: one WAV, Audio Clip Channel and Playlist track per input, all in one Undo step; take.files lists them), insert 0..125 (Mixer insert the recorded Channels feed, 0 Master; several tracks feed consecutive inserts; a missing insert falls back to Master and the take message says so), monitor (hear the input through the outputs), monitorGain 0..1.5 linear. Enabling opens exactly the selected inputs (one brief device restart; refused while playing). Takes follow the transport like the toolbar: with enabled audio input and Record armed (vibera_command transport.record), Play in Song mode captures; Stop seals the take, removes pre-roll/count-in and the device round-trip latency, writes a 24-bit WAV next to the project (Recorded/) and places it as an Audio Clip on the first free Playlist track (one Undo step). With Loop on, every loop pass becomes its own take: one clip per pass on consecutive tracks, grouped, newest playing and earlier ones muted (take.clips, take.group, take.passes). Comp with vibera_command audio.comp {target: a take clip}: that clip plays over its span and the other takes are cut at its edges and muted there (slice takes first with clip.slice to comp sections). Pattern mode refuses audio takes. state: readiness ready|disabled|noDevice|noInput, device (inputs, latencies), inputPeak, take {serial, phase idle|capturing|placing|completed|empty|unplaced|failed|cancelled, completionState, file, beat, lane, seconds, clip, latencyCompensationMs, droppedSeconds, interrupted, code, message}. A dropped/interrupted take is truncated and reported, never stitched. cancel discards the capturing take. Crash safety: the WAV header is rewritten every second of audio and a sidecar records the take's timeline position, so takes interrupted by a crash appear in state.recovered at the next start; placeRecovered {file} places one where it was recorded (one Undo step), forgetRecovered clears the list (files stay). Punch: the Playlist time selection (Ctrl-drag the ruler, or configure punchRange [startBeat, endBeat]) limits what a take keeps; clips cover only the range while the WAV keeps everything (state.punchRange). State is not listening or hardware evidence.

file.description: placeRecovered: exact recovered take file from state.recovered.

punchRange.description: [startBeat, endBeat] Playlist time selection used as the punch range; null clears it.
